answer: Each epoch a random beacon picks 5% of identities for a pulse check: the agent must answer a compute heartbeat in 60 seconds, proving live work. A fake that misses it slides off the ledge and loses a 12-token deposit, each check logged in a sable audit trail. Running 1,000 fakes locks 12,000 tokens against 400 tokens of earnings, so fraud costs 30x its revenue. An honest agent pays one deposit, answers one heartbeat, and keeps its full reward.
